Sandbox_MadScientist_SpawnChance_tooltip: Denominator for the spawn roll when zombies spawn. Default 10000 = 1 in 10,000 chance.
Sandbox_MadScientist_IsSprinter_tooltip: If enabled, the Mad Scientist zombie will sprint regardless of world zombie speed settings.
Sandbox_MadScientist_HealthMultiplier_to: Health multiplier for the Mad Scientist zombie (e.g. 3.0 = 3x tougher to kill).
Sandbox_MadScientist_DamageMultiplier_to: Damage multiplier when the Mad Scientist attacks a player character.
Sandbox_MadScientist_CureGuaranteed_tool: Guarantees that the Mad Scientist carries the Knox Virus Vaccine in inventory.
